summary_1line: Victor Frankenstein recounts his parents’ history and how the orphan Elizabeth Lavenza was adopted into the family and became his cherished companion.

image_candidates.scene_text: Caroline Beaufort kneels weeping beside her father’s coffin in a dim room as Alphonse Frankenstein enters like a rescuing figure.
In a poor Italian cottage, a golden-haired child with bright blue eyes stands among ragged dark-haired children while Victor’s mother gazes at her in wonder.
Young Victor meets the radiant Elizabeth in his family’s villa hall, seeing her as a shining gift presented by his mother.
